message:
{% set person = frappe.get_doc("Person", doc.parent) %}

Dear {{ person.first_name }},

Happy birthday from your church family! We are so thankful for you and pray that the Lord will bless you abundantly this year.

"This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it." — Psalm 118:24

With love,
{{ frappe.db.get_value("Church", {"parent_church": ["is", "not set"]}, "church_name") or "Your Church Family" }}
name: Birthday Greeting
subject: Happy Birthday, {{ frappe.db.get_value("Person", doc.parent, "first_name") }}!
